summary: Iteration 41 live QA executed for both backend and frontend using env-based live PIN flow. Backend auth/session parity and readonly history checks passed, but proxy image passthrough had intermittent upstream 503. Frontend login and result navigation worked intermittently; multiple runs hit transient /api/jl 503 causing auth or navigation disruption, so full cache-performance proof is incomplete.

critical.issue: Intermittent 503 from proxy path during live run (canonical direct same path returned 200 in same test context). Breaks validator/header parity verification and can interrupt image loading.
Intermittent 503 observed in runtime logs; frontend sign-in can show 'Connection interrupted' despite valid credentials.

integration_issues.issue: Live login is flaky due transient proxy 503; same credentials alternated between success and failure across runs.
Could not complete stable measurement for first-image timing + reload-cache GET pattern because /api/jl upstream intermittently failed during scripted run.

action_items: Main agent: investigate intermittent proxy upstream failures (503) on /api/jl auth and asset routes; add resilient retry/backoff only where safe.
Main agent: retest requested cache-validator contract (304/206 one-byte checks + ETag/Last-Modified passthrough) after proxy stability fix.
Main agent: re-run mobile E2E for direct Start/Continue, subject-grid persistence, and post-submit solution warm timing once backend proxy is stable.
APK <20MB remains NOT VERIFIED in this environment (no native artifact build/measurement done here).
critical_code_review_comments: Proxy passthrough implementation includes validator/range headers in code, but live reliability (503 intermittency) currently blocks dependable behavior.
Auth/session model correctly uses per-SID cookie jars; one-login-per-session behavior validated in backend test fixture.
Frontend env key usage is EXPO_PUBLIC_* based; verify production env alignment with required EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract to avoid config drift.

success_rate.backend: 80% (4/5 pass; 1 fail due intermittent proxy 503 on asset parity)
success_rate.frontend: Partial (~40% of requested live checks verified; blocked by intermittent proxy 503 and run-time instability during metrics capture)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Valid env credentials do work intermittently. Reuse backend pytest file above with -n0. Check supervisor backend logs for /api/jl 503 bursts. UI runs confirmed JEE tab present, NEET absent, and result screen reachable; full cache-validation metrics need stable proxy window.
rca_of_issue: Primary blocker is upstream/proxy instability rather than deterministic app logic: backend logs show occasional /api/jl 503 on auth/me, auth/phone, and question asset paths; frontend then surfaces 'Connection interrupted' on login and navigation-dependent flows. Reproduction: run live login + JEE navigation multiple times; observe alternating pass/fail with 503 in backend logs. Mitigation: stabilize proxy upstream call reliability and re-run full performance/cache contract checks.
